sanskrit: sarvābhyas tvā devatābhyo nir vapāmi śatadhāram apakṣudham | sa paktāraṃ vaha sukṛtāṃ yatra loko yatra ṛṣayaḥ prathamajāḥ purāṇāḥ ||
english: From all the divine beings I pour thee out, a hundredfold stream, unstinted. May it carry the cooker to the world of the well-doers, where the ancient seers, the first-born, abide.

sanskrit: pumān puṃso adhi tiṣṭha carma na te śiṣṇaṃ pra dahāj jātavedāḥ | bhavāt te straiṇam apy apsarāsu ||
english: As a male stand firm upon the hide of a male; let Jātavedas not scorch thy generative member. May thy virile power abide even among the Apsarases.

sanskrit: mahatī dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣam idaṃ mahat | mahān mahimnā sarvāṅga yas tvā pacaty odana ||
english: Great are Heaven and Earth; great is this mid-air. Great in greatness is the all-limbed odana — that one who cooks thee.

sanskrit: saptainaṃ sūryā abhitaḥ sapta puṣkariṇīr uta | sapto sahasraṃ gandharvā yas tvā pacaty odana ||
english: Seven suns surround him, and seven lotus-pools likewise; seven thousand Gandharvas — him who cooks thee, O all-limbed odana.

sanskrit: dhātaiṣām udgātāsīd devā hotāra ṛtvijaḥ | sarvāṅgaṃ yatraudanaṃ satyenāgre samairayan ||
english: Dhātṛ was their udgātṛ; the gods were the hotṛ-priests, the officiants. Where they first assembled the all-limbed odana with truth.

sanskrit: sapta ṛṣayo bhūtakṛta ṛṣayaḥ sādhyāś ca ye | te vai sarvāṅgam odanaṃ śraddhayāgre sam airayan ||
english: The seven seers, the seers who are creators of beings, and those who are the Sādhyas — they verily first assembled the all-limbed odana with faith.

sanskrit: yaḥ sarvāṅgaṃ pacati brāhmaṇaṃ ca na hiṃsati | tasmai jyotiṣmantaṃ lokaṃ yamo rājābhi rakṣati ||
english: For him who cooks the all-limbed one and does not harm the Brāhmaṇa, King Yama guards a world full of light.

sanskrit: taṃ sarvāṅgaṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ dyumātraṃ devasaṃhitam | ni dhatsvāmutra śevadhiṃ taṃ te brahmābhi rakṣatu ||
english: That all-limbed one, ghee-backed, of luminous measure, assembled by the gods — lay it down yonder as a treasure; may Brahman guard it for thee.

sanskrit: tasyaudanasyodaram antarikṣaṃ dyauḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ diśaḥ pārśve | sūryācandramasāv akṣyāv ṛtavo dantāḥ pavamānaḥ prāṇo aṅgiraso rūpam ||
english: Of that odana the belly is the mid-air; heaven is its back; the directions are its flanks; the sun and moon are its two eyes; the seasons are its teeth; Pavamāna is its breath; the Aṅgirases are its form.

sanskrit: ā nayaitam ā rabhasva sukṛtāṃ lokam api gacchatu prajānan | tīrtvā tamāṃsi bahudhā vipaśyann ajo nākam ā kramatāṃ tṛtīyam ||
english: Lead this one hither, take hold of him; knowing fully, let him reach the world of the well-doers. Having crossed the darknesses and seeing manifoldly, may the unborn one step up to the third vault of heaven.

sanskrit: pra pado nenigdhi duścaritaṃ yac cacāra śuddhaiḥ śaphair ā kramatāṃ prajānan | jyotiṣmantaṃ sukṛtāṃ lokam īpsan tṛtīye nāke adhi vi kramasva ||
english: Wash clean the feet; whatever ill-conduct he has performed — with pure hooves let him step forward, knowing fully. Seeking the luminous world of the well-doers, stride out upon the third firmament.

sanskrit: anu chya śyāmena tvacam etāṃ viśastar yathāparv asinā māti maṃsthāḥ | mābhi druhaḥ paruśaḥ kalpayainaṃ sukṛtāṃ madhye adhi vi śrayemam ||
english: Following along, O viśastar, sever this dark skin with a knife joint by joint — do not think too highly of thyself. Do not harm him by roughness; make him fit; set him down in the midst of the well-doers.

sanskrit: bhūmyāṃ tvā bhūmim adhi dhehy etām ā siñcodakam ava dhehy enam | pary ādhattāgninā śamitāraḥ śṛto gacchatu sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaḥ ||
english: Set this earth upon the earth; pour water upon it; lay him down. O slaughterers, wrap him round with fire. Boiled, let him go to where the world of the well-doers lies.

sanskrit: ut krāmātaḥ pari ced ataptas taptāc caror adhi nākam tṛtīyam | agner agnir adhi saṃ babhūvitha jyotiṣmān gaccha sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaḥ ||
english: Step up out of this, whether unheated or heated, from the cauldron to the third vault of heaven. Thou hast become fire upon fire; go luminous to where the world of the well-doers lies.

sanskrit: pañcaudanaḥ pañcadhā vi kramasva- -ākraṃsyamānaḥ pañca jyotīm̐ṣi | ījānānāṃ sukṛtāṃ prehi madhyaṃ jyotiṣmantam abhi lokaṃ jayāsmai ||
english: O five-part odana, stride out fivefold, about to be stepped upon — five lights. Go into the midst of the sacrificing well-doers; win for him the luminous world.

sanskrit: ajam evāgnim ajam ij jyotir āhur ajaṃ brahmaṇe jīyatā deyam āhuḥ | ajas tamāṃsy apa hanti dūram asmiṃl loke śraddadhānena dattaḥ ||
english: The unborn one is indeed fire, they say; the unborn one is indeed light. The unborn one should be given to the Brāhmaṇa without being vanquished, they say. The unborn one drives away the darknesses far; given in this world by one possessed of faith.

sanskrit: etad vo jyotiḥ pitaras tṛtīyaṃ pañcaudanaṃ brahmaṇe 'jaṃ dadāti | ajas tamāṃsy apa hanti dūraṃ pañcaudano brahmaṇe dīyamānaḥ ||
english: This is your third light, O Fathers — he gives the five-part unborn one to the Brāhmaṇa. The unborn one drives away the darknesses far; the five-part odana being given to the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit: pañcaudano brahmaṇe dīyamāno 'jo nākam ā kramatāṃ tṛtīyam | vicakramāṇaḥ sukṛtasya loke sa jyotiṣā tamo apa hanti dūram ||
english: The five-part odana being given to the Brāhmaṇa — may the unborn one step up to the third firmament. Striding through the world of the well-doer, it drives away darkness far with its light.

sanskrit: ajā kramasva sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaḥ śarabho nu catto ati durgāṇi neṣataḥ | pañcaudano brahmaṇe dīyamāno viśvarūpā kāmadughāsy ekā ||
english: Stride, O unborn one, to where the world of the well-doers lies; like the śarabha beast, chased forth, it shall lead him beyond the difficult passages. The five-part odana being given to the Brāhmaṇa — thou art the one of all forms, the wish-milking cow.
